articles.title: Fastly to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
articles.mainIdea: Fastly to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
articles.summary: Business Wire: Fastly to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results. SAN FRANCISCO, January 15, 2026--Fastly, Inc. (NASDAQ: FSLY), a leading global edge platform, will release financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025 after market close on Wednesday, February 11, 2026. Fastly will host an investor conference call that day to discuss its results at 1:30 p.m. PT / 4:30 p.m. ET.
